title: Gemini on your iPad
summary: Choose a chat model, set its thinking time, or hand a longer assignment to Tasks.

sections.title: What your account can select
paragraphs: On an iPad, open Gemini and tap the model name at the bottom of the chat box. In Auto, Gemini chooses between Hydrogen and a lighter model and sets the thinking level. To request Neon or Carbon specifically, select the name where your plan offers it.
These are Google’s published personal-account choices on November 22, 2026. A school or employer can license a different set. Region, rollout and remaining usage also affect what appears.
sources: Google Help · model choices on iPad

sections.title: Spend thinking time where it counts
paragraphs: For a rewrite with a clear target, Hydrogen at Low is a sensible starting point. For a comparison with exceptions and overlapping conditions, try Neon at Medium or High. Reserve a Carbon trial for a problem you can actually check, such as reconciling a long set of requirements against a draft implementation.

In the app, manual model selection starts at Low. Higher thinking levels consume more usage. For a fair comparison, give each model the same input in a fresh chat. For example, supply two versions of a parking policy and ask for a table of changed hours, exemptions and exact supporting passages. Count missed exceptions and check each quotation against the documents.
sources: Google Help · model choices on iPad
Google AI Studio · choosing a model

sections.title: Chat, Tasks or Deep Research?
paragraphs: Chat suits a back-and-forth over a draft. Tasks can continue a multistep assignment in the background. Google’s November 17 release began rolling out free Tasks in the United States, India, Canada, Australia, Japan and Korea. A sample task is a draft itinerary with separate train and walking times.

Choose Deep Research for a question that requires gathering evidence. Start with “Compare wheelchair-accessible station transfers on these two routes using the rail operators’ own information. Show which transfers are still unconfirmed.” Read the proposed plan, narrow its scope if needed, and open the operator page behind each consequential claim.
sources: Google · how Deep Research plans and reports

title: Inside the Gemini model catalog
summary: Match a model ID, input type and reasoning budget to the task your application has to perform.

sections.title: Five general-purpose choices
paragraphs: An API model ID selects the engine a program calls. These are first candidates to test. The job examples are editorial suggestions. The consumer picker on the previous page and the developer catalog have different lineups.

The API offers Hydrogen and Flash-Lite on free and paid tiers. Neon and Carbon require a paid API tier. Google lists Argon separately as a stable model. Its October 13 release predates Carbon, Hydrogen and Neon, which reached general availability November 10, 12 and 18 respectively.
sources: Google AI Studio · choosing a model
Google · model release and retirement dates

rows: High-volume classification. Tag 2,000 trivia cards by category against known labels.
Responsive everyday work. Extract a schedule from a scanned flyer, then ask a follow-up.
Complex interactive work. Trace a calculation across several files while a developer waits.
Longer verification jobs. Give it a failing feature, the expected behavior and test cases.
An additional coding, math and reasoning option. Benchmark existing Argon workloads before switching.

sections.title: What fits and what comes back
paragraphs: Gemini 4 general models accept documents, pictures, sound, video and text, and produce text. A video input can yield a written shot list. To generate a new clip, use a video-generation model. Likewise, analysis of a book cover and illustration of a book cover are different jobs.

Google lists a combined input-and-output window of 1,048,576 tokens for the Gemini 4 models. Ordinary synchronous output tops out at 65,536 tokens. Longer generation uses a separate long-decode configuration and still needs space alongside the input. Leave room for the answer and ask for page or time references. Capacity alone does not establish that every detail was found.
sources: Google AI Studio · full model directory

sections.title: Keep older applications reproducible
paragraphs: The wider directory also includes models such as 3.8 Flash and 3.6 Flash, and entries explicitly marked preview, such as 3.1 Pro Preview. Read the endpoint’s own lifecycle page when inheriting a project. A date or generation number alone says little about its present availability.

One concrete migration was pending at this edition’s review. Google scheduled requests using gemini-2.5-pro to route to 3.8 Flash on December 1, 2026, and gemini-2.5-flash to 3.5 Flash-Lite on the same day. Replacement pricing applies. Keep a short test set, record the requested ID and date, then compare the replacement’s answers, timing and cost before a switchover.
sources: Google AI Studio · full model directory

title: Gemini in Chrome, Drive and your notebook
summary: Decide whether your evidence lives in open tabs, a connected account or a collection of selected documents.

sections.title: Read the tabs you choose
paragraphs: On a supported desktop, Gemini in Chrome lives in the browser toolbar and can use shared tab content. Try opening two manufacturers’ specification sheets. Ask for the maximum material thickness, the units and the exact sentence behind each number. Compare the result to the same rows in the original sheets. “Maximum material height” and “cutting thickness” can describe different things.

Opening the Gemini website gives you a chat. Browser integration gives the assistant page context you choose to share. Chrome on iOS has its own rollout and controls. Use the current device help if the toolbar differs on your iPad.
sources: Google · Gemini in Chrome and device availability

sections.title: Let Gemini look in the right account
paragraphs: Connected Apps can make Gmail messages and calendar information available to Gemini, subject to your permissions. You can name a connected app in a prompt. Try “Find my latest rail confirmation in Gmail. Extract the station name, departure time and booking date. Include the email reference.” Check that it found the revised confirmation before using the details.

The personal-account controls let you connect and disconnect services individually. Google says that switching off Gemini History disables Connected Apps on the web and iOS. An organizational account has its own rules, so two people on the same device can see different choices.

sections.title: Study a source collection
paragraphs: Gemini Notebook lets you select which uploaded sources a chat should use and follow citations back to the supporting passage. For certification review, load the current handbook and practice notes. Select the handbook alone to ask which competencies are expressly listed. Then include the notes and ask which topics have no examples yet.

Click a citation and read the surrounding text. A sentence mentioning a topic can still fall short of supporting the proposed answer. For research that needs new material from the open web, switch to Deep Research and inspect its research plan.
sources: Google Help · source selection and citations in Gemini Notebook

title: Google AI Studio and Antigravity
summary: Use AI Studio to compare model behavior, then use a coding workspace when the job involves a real project.

sections.title: Run a controlled experiment in AI Studio
paragraphs: Open Playground, choose a model and prepare three small inputs with answers you know. For an event extractor, use one flyer with two showtimes, one with an ambiguous date and one with no date. Give the instruction “Return title, local date and times. Use null for a missing date. Preserve every printed showtime.”

Run the same three inputs with Flash-Lite and Hydrogen. Compare the returned dates and the number of showtimes. If the output will feed another program, specify structured output in Run settings and validate the result against the expected fields. A valid structure can still hold the wrong date. When the experiment meets your checks, Get code shows how to reproduce the call.
sources: Google · AI Studio Playground and Run settings

sections.title: From a prompt to an app
paragraphs: Build mode can create an application from a description or import a GitHub project. A useful first prototype is a review screen that shows the extracted event beside the uploaded flyer and lets a person correct it. Specify what should happen when the date is missing and try that case in the preview.

For a web app that makes paid model calls, AI Studio keeps its API key in the server-side environment. Shared app usage can count against the builder’s quota. A public, offline bookshelf can instead contain the finished entries as local files. A live Gemini request from the reader would require a connection and a separately hosted service to protect the key.
sources: Google · Build mode, sharing and API keys

sections.title: Work on a repository with Google Antigravity
paragraphs: Antigravity is Google’s agent development environment. Its desktop app has a change-review pane. The browser tool can exercise a running app, inspect errors and capture screenshots. There are also IDE and command-line surfaces, with browser support depending on the version, account and workspace.

For a bookshelf change, start on a working branch. Ask “Add a search box for chapter titles. Keep Previous and Next working on iPad, including after clearing the search.” Have the agent open the local preview and demonstrate a match, no matches, and an empty query. In the review pane, read which files changed and try the controls yourself before publishing.
sources: Google Antigravity · app and change review
Google Antigravity · browser tools and availability

title: Google’s image, video and audio tools
summary: Pick the tool by the artifact you need, from an editable picture to a spoken conversation.

sections.title: Make and revise a still image
paragraphs: The Gemini app offers Nano Banana image creation and editing. Google’s US page lists Nano Banana 2.1 for eligible Google AI plans. In the API, Nano Banana 2.1 is the general starting point for iterative image work. Nano Banana 2 Lite prioritizes speed and cost, while Nano Banana Pro targets demanding layouts, text and visual consistency. The earlier Nano Banana 2 is also listed.

For a book cover, give the subject, framing, orientation and empty space needed for lettering. Example: “Portrait-format studio photograph of a brass key on midnight-blue felt, soft light from the left, upper third empty.” Then ask for just one change, such as a darker background. Add the final title as editable text when exact spelling and typography matter.
sources: Google · image creation in the Gemini app
Google · Nano Banana API family and exact model IDs

sections.title: Make a clip or an interactive world
paragraphs: Gemini Omni makes and edits video from prompts and reference media. Google’s consumer page describes Omni replacing Veo in the Gemini app and lists subscription, age and regional conditions. The separate November 5 API announcement confirms Omni 1.2 Flash with clips up to 15 seconds and edits across turns. App access and API clip lengths can differ.

Try supplying a still of your book on a desk. Specify one slow camera move and a stationary book. On the second pass request a lighting change. Watch the title, cover corners and background from first frame to last to see what drifted. For a world a viewer can steer live, Google launched the separate Genie 4 API model on November 19.
sources: Google · Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash release, November 5

sections.title: Match an audio tool to what goes in and out
paragraphs: “Make audio” can mean four different jobs. Decide what you start with and what the listener needs. For a two-person recording, verify proper names and speaker changes against the original. For synthetic narration, listen for acronyms and pauses at headings.
sources: Google · Lyria music generation in Gemini

rows: Lyria 3.5 in Gemini. Specify mood, arrangement and whether you want vocals or an instrumental.
Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS. Supply your script and describe the intended delivery.
Turn a recording into searchable text
Gemini 3.5 Transcribe. Use timestamp and speaker information to locate a passage.
Gemini Live in the app, or the Live API for your own application. The user can interrupt and ask a follow-up.
